dataRecordMapping.description:
Provides a mapping from a data record returned by an api call, which may be in any shape,
to the shape required by the concrete data spec setting type implementation.

fieldName.description: The name of the field to which these settings apply

colorMap.description:
The colorMap should map a color to a list of property values to which this color should apply.
Only colors belonging to {@link UiSdlGraphVisualizationFillColorOption} can be used.

title:
Color the node, edge or GeoJSON region based on a specified field's value in the data.
If the item is a node or an edge, the values of the field will be grouped, and nodes or edges which match the
grouped value will be assigned a color based on a default list of colors. Optionally, the
{@link UiSdlGraphVisualizationFillColorByPropertyStrategyCategorical#colorMap} can be used to pass in a pre-defined
color for each category.

If the item is a GeoJSON region, the specified field value will be used to color the region. The component assumes
the field value is a valid color, i.e., Color.fromString() does not throw an error.
name: UiSdlGraphVisualizationFillColorByPropertyStrategyCategorical
